propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and hard-fails when the file is absent, but Gerrit's Verified lane sources the workflow definition from the target branch, causing every change branched before the gate landed to fail regardless of its content.

Changes branched before commit c433663721 (ticket 980d) lack .github/git-version-floor.txt in their tree, so they receive the new gate step from main but fail on the missing file, producing false Verified -1 votes.

The gate's missing-file error message does not name the real cause (tree-skew from definition-vs-patchset mismatch) or remedy (rebase or post-merge re-run), sending authors hunting for a file they never touched.

The fix applies the established if-present guard pattern (documented in the workflow as ticket ee2a) to skip with a diagnostic log line when the floor file is absent, preserving the actual enforcement (under-floor git detection) unchanged.
